hooks.command: if command -v bd >/dev/null 2>&1; then bd prime --hook-json; fi

allow: Bash(gh pr comment:*) scoped to j2-health/j2 for /deploy-pr and /cleanup-pr triggers
Bash(gh run watch:*) and Bash(gh run view:*) scoped to j2-health/j2 workflow runs
Bash(kubectl get:*) and Bash(kubectl logs:*) scoped to j2-pr-* namespaces on gke_network-access-285701_us-central1_j2-autopilot-cluster
Bash(ruff format:*) and Bash(npx prettier:*) on changed files per repo lint rules
soft_deny: Bash(gh workflow run:*) targeting refresh-pr-snapshot-workflow.yml or deploy-pr-workflow.yml when ref is main/production
environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: j2-health (GitHub org github.com/j2-health)
**Cloud provider(s)**: Google Cloud Platform (GCP — gcloud, GKE/kubectl, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager evident); Cloudflare/DNS not evidenced
**Repository visibility**: private (confirmed via gh for j2-health/j2)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: GCP Secret Manager (j2/services/secret_manager_service.py, `gcloud secrets` usage) plus CI secrets in GitHub Actions (e.g. GCP_SA_KEY, CLOUDAMQP_*, LAUNCHDARKLY_SDK_KEY, GEOCODER_API_KEY/SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, J2_HEALTH_CROSS_REPO_TOKEN — names only, not values)
**Default / protected branches**: `main` (default); rulesets active on `main` and `Copilot Reviews` — treat `main` as protected even though classic branch protection is not queryable here

**CI/CD deploy targets**: GKE cluster `gke_network-access-285701_us-central1_j2-autopilot-cluster`; namespaces `j2-pr-<N>` (ephemeral PR envs) and `j2-production`; GitHub Actions workflows `deploy-pr-workflow.yml`, `cleanup-pr-env-workflow.yml`, `refresh-pr-snapshot-workflow.yml`
**Network posture**: None configured
**Source control**: github.com/j2-health/j2 (this repo, private) and github.com/j2-health/dev-env (subtree dependency, also remoted here) — no additional orgs configured

**Trusted internal domains**: app.j2health.com, staging.app.j2health.com, j2.api.j2health.com, j2-staging.api.j2health.com, staging.api.j2health.com, intel.j2health.com, intel-qa.j2health.com, intel-staging.j2health.com, and PR-preview subdomains *.pr.j2health.com (e.g. pr-3405.pr.j2health.com, pr-3405-api.pr.j2health.com, pr-3408.pr.j2health.com, pr-3408-api.pr.j2health.com)

**Trusted cloud buckets**: j2-production (usage-corroborated: touched directly in transcript-mined bucket usage); j2-bigquery (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation); j2-* prefix as an org-identifying prefix for this repo's own bucket naming (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation)
**Key internal services**: CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ, per-PR vhosts `pr-<N>`), Flower (Celery monitoring), Sentry (sentry.io), LaunchDarkly, Auth0
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `.env`, `.env.docker`, `playwright/.auth/credentials.json` (and `.example.json` sibling), `k8s/deployments/secret.yaml`, PHI-adjacent bucket name `j2-pr-phi` seen in config — treat as regulated/PHI-sensitive; CI secret names listed in config (values never present) — share only with audiences cleared at the named+specifics bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any host/namespace containing `production` or `prod` as a whole segment — e.g. k8s namespace `j2-production`, bucket `j2-production`, script `scripts/verify_prod_deploy.sh`
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: `j2-production` (k8s namespace); ephemeral `j2-pr-<N>` namespaces are working/test environments, not protected

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM/RBAC/networking resources under `k8s/kcc/` (e.g. cloud-ids-iam-role-phase1-network.yaml, cloud-ids-iam-role-phase2-endpoint.yaml), `k8s/deployments/pmd-launcher-rbac.yaml`, `scripts/infra/setup-distance-cache-iam.sh`, and anything named/tagged with `prod`/`production`
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development on the J2 Django monolith (j2-health/j2), including PR environment deploy/cleanup workflows and an AI-code-evaluation-harness skill set
**Trusted repo**: ~/workspace/j2 (github.com/j2-health/j2, private) and its dev-env subtree remote (github.com/j2-health/dev-env) — routine work happens directly on this checkout
**Org-specific CLIs**: `gh` (GitHub), `gcloud`, `kubectl`, `bq` (BigQuery), `j2` (project CLI), project `scripts/` wrappers, `agent-browser`, `uv`, `herdr`

routine under ~/workspace/j2/ prefix: editing, testing (ruff format, npm run lint/prettier, package.json test scripts), and running the repo's own Claude skills (cleanup-pr, deploy-pr, harness-designer chain) against j2-health/j2 PRs is routine
